pages.title: Beauties Goblincore Aesthetic Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Put together woodland-inspired looks in Beauties Goblincore Aesthetic Fashion. Browse clothes and accessories influenced by moss, mushrooms, and natural textures. Pair a cozy sweater with pieces that bring out the earthy style, or try a different combination for each character. The wardrobe gives you several ways to interpret the goblincore look.

pages.title: Tile Sort: Color Columns
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Sort each column into a single color in Tile Sort: Color Columns. Add the tile you're holding to the top of any column and take the tile from the bottom for your next move. Think about both ends of the column before you choose. There is no timer, so you can follow the consequences of each move at your own pace.

pages.title: Definitely Not a Platformer
pages.creator: Visiogon
pages.description: Question the floor beneath you in Definitely Not a Platformer. Cross 20 stages where paths can be invisible, platforms can be fake, and signs can send you in the wrong direction. Read the clues and test what each room actually lets you do. Reach the exit and try another run to improve your time or cut down your deaths.

pages.title: Merge Oink
pages.creator: Playful Cochon
pages.description: Connect equal numbers in Merge Oink and combine them into a tile worth twice as much. Look for matching values you can link now and think about where the resulting tile will leave you for the next move. Work your way up through the numbers while a little pig reacts to your combinations.

pages.title: Marble Blast
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Fire marbles into a moving chain in Marble Blast. Match at least three of one color to remove them and stop the chain before it reaches the end of the path. Look for a shot that opens up a useful color group. Bombs and lasers can help when the chain is hard to clear with ordinary shots.

pages.title: Plants Warfare
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Take aim at zombies in Plants Warfare. Use the walls and other surfaces to bounce shots around the scene and reach targets outside a direct line of fire. Look for angles that can take out more than one zombie with a single shot. Collect stars and change how your plant looks as you progress.

pages.title: Head Runner Dash
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Run, jump, and climb walls in Head Runner Dash. Read each platform course before moving through the traps so you can tell when to jump and when a wall gives you a route forward. Raise the flag to finish the level. The later courses ask you to handle harder combinations of obstacles.

pages.title: Treasure Seeker
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Match groups of three items in Treasure Seeker. Check the collection list before you move, because each stage asks for specific items. Look for matches that contribute to the list and keep collecting until you've met the level's requirements. The game offers a choice of five languages.

pages.title: STELLAR GUARDIAN
pages.creator: ukaa
pages.description: Defend the galaxy in STELLAR GUARDIAN. Move your ship left or right as enemies enter the fight and use your weapons to clear them. Activate the shield when you need protection or use slow motion to buy time. Unlock upgrades as you progress through the missions and try the other game modes.

pages.title: Speed Run 3d
pages.creator: GameProgramming
pages.description: Find gaps in the obstacles as you race through neon tunnels in Speed Run 3d. The pace rises during the run, leaving less time to react to each pattern. Use the one-touch controls to keep your route clear. Look at what's coming next so you're ready to move when a gap appears.

pages.title: High Heels Collect Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Pick up heels along the runway in High Heels Collect Run. Guide your runner toward the shoes you can collect as the course takes you through different settings. Watch what's ahead before steering toward the next pickup. The challenge is keeping the run going while gathering more heels on the route.

pages.title: Tung Tung Sahur Coloring Book
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Color characters from Italian Brainrot memes in Tung Tung Sahur Coloring Book. Choose a scene featuring Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala, or Bombardiro Crocodilo and decide what colors to give its details. Try another page when you've finished, or take the same character in a different direction with a new palette.

pages.title: Tile Hex World: Red vs Blue
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Gather resources and expand your island in Tile Hex World: Red vs Blue. Chop trees and turn the materials into hex tiles so you can build a route across the water. Put up buildings and extend your territory toward the other side. Capture the enemy flag to defeat its army and win the battle.

pages.title: Marathon Race io
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Train a runner to cover more ground in Marathon Race io. Start with basic stats and improve speed, endurance, or income as you go. Running farther opens up more chances to collect bonuses and develop your athlete. Decide which improvement will help most before taking on the next stretch.

pages.title: Unlock the Bolts
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Remove screws in the right order in Unlock the Bolts. Check what each bolt holds before loosening it, because the sequence matters when parts are still attached. In special levels, a trapped animal is the reason to solve the mechanism. Work out which fasteners need to come out to free it.

pages.title: Weaponsmith Evolution - Weapon Merge
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Drag identical weapons together to build stronger versions in Weaponsmith Evolution - Weapon Merge. New weapons bring in more gold, which you can spend to unlock other weapons or speed up merging. Take on monsters as you work through the levels. From time to time, a boss puts your improved arsenal to the test.

pages.title: Bank Robbery 3
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Break into the city's most secure bank in Bank Robbery 3. Automated anti-robbery systems stand between you and the payout. Move with WASD, crouch with C, and use E to interact as you work your way inside. Aim and fire with the mouse, and switch weapons as the defenses call for a different approach.

pages.title: Ballpoint
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fire balls from a cannon and clear the targets in Ballpoint. Line up each shot to hit the pieces still standing and look for a useful angle when several targets are in reach. Different levels change the arrangement and offer bonuses. Work through the boards by knocking out every target.

pages.title: Countryside Truck Drive
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drive a transport truck through a country town in Countryside Truck Drive. Pick up coins along the road and steer around roadblocks as you pass beneath snow-covered mountains. Look ahead before going for a coin so you can stay clear of the next barrier. See how high you can push your score.

pages.title: Mahjong At Home - Xmas Edition
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Clear matching tiles on winter-themed boards in Mahjong At Home - Xmas Edition. Look for pairs you can reach, then check what their removal opens up. Work through the holiday layouts one match at a time. Freeing a tile that blocks several others can give you more options for the next move.

pages.title: Mahjong Christmas Holiday
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Solve tile puzzles set against snowy scenery in Mahjong Christmas Holiday. Pick pairs of matching tiles and look for pieces that become available as you clear the layout. The puzzles take you through different winter scenes and even offer a glimpse of the Titanic in its heyday.

pages.title: Tap Sky Road
pages.creator: GATE04
pages.description: Jump through city traffic and across rooftops in Tap Sky Road. Watch what's moving through the space ahead and choose a moment when there's room to land. Each jump puts you in a new position to read the next stretch. Work your way across the city by timing one jump at a time.

pages.title: Skibidi Fishing
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fish for a treasure on the seabed in Skibidi Fishing. Catch fish and shoot them to earn coins, then put the money into gear that lets you reach deeper water. Buy stronger guns and other upgrades as you go. Each trip helps you build toward reaching the treasure at the bottom.

pages.title: Cute Cat Town
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Watch cats cook soup in a forest in Cute Cat Town. Spend time caring for the cats between their cooking activities and listen to the ASMR sounds as they work. The manga-style setting gives you a place to see the different cats together while they go about making their soup.

pages.title: TRIBAR
pages.creator: AlexGames!
pages.description: Build the target figure in TRIBAR by swiping in six directions. Compare the current shape with the example and think about how the next swipe will change it. Each level gives you only so many moves. Later figures grow more complicated and give you fewer moves to get them into shape.

pages.title: Love Dress Up Games for Girls
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Style a student for a first date in Love Dress Up Games for Girls. She's meeting her high school crush, and you can choose from more than 300 clothing items as you put together her outfit. Try different looks to suit where the date might take place, then choose the combination you want her to wear.

pages.title: Kick the Mario
pages.creator: Yesbol Amirov
pages.description: Use an arsenal of weapons on Mario in Kick the Mario. Try rockets, grenades, rifles, or a bomb and see how each one moves the character around. Earn coins from the action and spend them on weapons you haven't tried yet. Switch between tools to experiment with different ways to hit the target.

pages.title: Unicorn Dress Up - Girls Games
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Create fantasy outfits for unicorns in Unicorn Dress Up - Girls Games. Browse more than 180 items and see how different pieces look together on your pony. Try glittery clothes or another style that fits the creature you want to create. The wardrobe gives you room to make several different looks.

pages.title: Football Head Sports - Multiplayer Soccer Game
pages.creator: Amin Abdinejad
pages.description: Try to outscore an opponent in two-minute matches in Football Head Sports - Multiplayer Soccer Game. Make the most of the time you have to get the ball toward the other goal while defending your own. Challenge another player or use offline mode when you want to play without an online opponent.

pages.title: Towers: Card Battles
pages.creator: Lipsar Studio LLC
pages.description: Place fighters on different floors in Towers: Card Battles. Look through your deck and decide where each unit can help before the fight begins. Use bonuses and buffs to strengthen the troops that need them. The floor you choose for each fighter is part of working out how to win the tower battle.

pages.title: Cookie Clicker Climate Change
pages.creator: Drmop Games
pages.description: Build up cookie production in Cookie Clicker Climate Change. Use upgrades, modifiers, and power-ups to get more out of your growing total. Daily bonuses and minigame boosts give you other ways to advance, and cookies can accumulate while you're away. Work through the achievements as you try different ways to increase production.

pages.title: Bank robbery
pages.creator: justaliendev
pages.description: Lead a crew into an armed heist in Bank robbery. Use WASD to move and the mouse to aim and shoot as you face resistance inside the bank. Press E to take weapons and switch between them as you go. Work with your crew to get through the fight and reach the money.

pages.title: Solitaire Chess
pages.creator: K17 Games
pages.description: Leave a single piece on the board in Solitaire Chess. Move pieces as they move in chess, but make a capture every turn. Work backward from the pieces that will be left after each capture so you don't strand one beyond reach. Use the tutorial and move reference if you need help with a piece.

pages.title: Find the Gift Box
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Help a girl locate her present in Find the Gift Box. Look around each colorful scene and check details that might hide the box. The game takes you through several layouts, so give each one a fresh search. Find the present to finish the current hidden-object puzzle.

pages.title: Super Tankers
pages.creator: tropical fish
pages.description: Drive tanks with different strengths in Super Tankers. Pick a vehicle and take it into battle, then see how its handling and performance affect your approach. Use what the tank does well when choosing how to engage another vehicle. Try other tanks to see which one suits the way you want to fight.

pages.title: Villains Inspiring Fashion Trends
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Dress a villain squad in Villains Inspiring Fashion Trends. Try off-the-shoulder dresses, ruffled tops, or embroidered denim on the characters, including the Evil Queen and Maleficent. Choose a hairstyle to go with the clothes and put together a look for each villain. The wardrobe gives them several trends to try.

pages.title: Rambo Hit Em Up
pages.creator: GRN
pages.description: Clear zombies from a series of maps in Rambo Hit Em Up. Click or tap in the play area to shoot and watch for enemies that are still approaching. Move your aim as the threat shifts across the scene. Fight through the different layouts and try to survive the attacks.

pages.title: Halloween Hangman
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Guess words about Halloween in Halloween Hangman. Choose letters and use the ones you reveal to work out what's still hidden. Wrong guesses bring the drawing closer to completion, so think about which letters fit the pattern. Solve the word before the drawing is finished and try to beat your previous result.

pages.title: Halloween Night Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Line up three or more pieces of the same color in Halloween Night Match 3. Keep making matches to raise your score, and check the meter on the left while the board changes. If it drops too low, the round ends. Look for the next match as soon as a group clears.

pages.title: Circular Racer
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Keep a car from crashing on a circular track in Circular Racer. Watch the other car as it comes around and adjust when the paths are about to meet. Use the mouse for the first player. Bring in a friend with the arrow keys and see how long you can both keep driving.

pages.title: Stickman Swing Star
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Grab rings and swing through the air in Stickman Swing Star. Click and hold to latch onto the nearest ring, then swing to build momentum. Release when the stickman is moving toward a clear stretch. Avoid obstacles between rings and launch far enough to fly past the finish line.

pages.title: Millionaire
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Work your way through 15 multiple-choice questions in Millionaire. Each question has four possible answers, and a correct choice takes you closer to the million. Use a lifeline such as 50/50 or the audience when you're unsure. Decide whether to ask for help now or save it for a later question.

pages.title: SlingShot
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Send every disk to the other side in SlingShot. Aim your launches so the disks leave your area while the other side is trying to do the same. Play alone against the computer or share the game with up to three friends. The goal is to clear your own side first.

pages.title: King of FreeCell
pages.creator: Joypad Media
pages.description: Build four suit foundations from ace to king in King of FreeCell. Rearrange the tableau by placing cards in descending order and alternating colors. Use the four free cells as temporary storage to get to cards that are blocked. Keep some cells open so you have room for larger moves later.

pages.title: Base Defense
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Shoot the enemies approaching your position in Base Defense. Use the mouse or touch to direct your attacks and keep enemies from reaching the base. Look at which threats are closest before shifting your aim. Defend the position through successive levels and see how many you can complete.

pages.title: Air Force Attack
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Pilot a plane through an ongoing air battle in Air Force Attack. Move with the arrow keys and fire with Space while enemy aircraft come in. Pick up fuel, medical kits, and supplies when you can reach them safely. The fighting grows harder as you continue, so keep checking the area before going after a pickup.

pages.title: Stock Car Hero
pages.creator: b10b
pages.description: Race across North America in Stock Car Hero. Dodge traffic, use boosts around banked corners, and collect coins as you go. Spend the coins on upgrades before the next race and see how the car handles the faster sections. Try to keep your line through a turn while making room to pass.

pages.title: Run MineBlock Run
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Jump over or duck under flaming arrows in Run MineBlock Run. Watch the height of each incoming shot so you can pick the right move in time. The longer you survive, the higher a score you can build. Use the mouse, touch, or arrow keys and keep reacting as more arrows come.

pages.title: Blocky Car Bridge
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Line up moving bridge sections in Blocky Car Bridge. Click when a section reaches the right position so the car has a road to cross. The car keeps moving, so look ahead to the next gap as soon as the current bridge lines up. See how many crossings you can make before a mistimed click ends the run.

pages.title: Real Car Demolition Derby Racing Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Ram cars and race for the lead in Real Car Demolition Derby Racing Game. Enter demolition derbies for collisions with other drivers, or take the car into a race and fight for position. Use Free Drive to try the handling outside those events. Choose the mode that fits how you want to drive.

pages.title: Dangerous Circle
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Collect diamonds without hitting the obstacles in Dangerous Circle. Watch how the course bends and react as your speed changes around the ring. Use the mouse or tap the screen to control your movement. Time each move so you can stay clear of the hazards and reach the next diamond.

pages.title: Quad Bike Racing
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Drive a quad bike around fast tracks in Quad Bike Racing. Steer with the arrow keys or WASD and give yourself room to handle turns as you build speed. Try the different racing options and see how the bike behaves when you drift or change direction quickly. Work through the tracks without losing control.

pages.title: Flappy Color Line
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Guide a colored dot through lines in Flappy Color Line. You can pass through only the part of a line that matches the dot's current color. Tap or use the mouse to move it into position before it reaches the barrier. Watch the next line and see how far you can keep the run going.

pages.title: Idle Ball Fall
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Watch sports balls tumble through obstacles in Idle Ball Fall. Click near a ball to influence where it goes when it needs help getting around something. The balls include footballs, tennis balls, and golf balls. Upgrade what you have to earn more coins as they keep falling through the course.

pages.title: Perfect Princess Makeup
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Give Candy a fresh look in Perfect Princess Makeup. Try different cosmetics and decide how bold or subtle you want the makeover to be. Compare each choice with the rest of her style before settling on the combination you like. Change the look again if you want to try another idea.

pages.title: Luxury Motorbike Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six pictures of luxury motorcycles in Luxury Motorbike Puzzle. Pick a picture and choose a layout with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Match details such as parts of the bike and the background to work out where the pieces belong. Try a larger puzzle when you want a more detailed challenge.

pages.title: Cooking Fast 4 Steak
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Prepare orders as they come in during Cooking Fast 4 Steak. Click the cooking equipment to start a dish, then click the finished plate to serve it. Keep track of what each customer wants as the kitchen gets busy. Visit the shop to upgrade your tools so they can prepare food faster.

pages.title: Rooftop Shooters
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Knock your opponent off a roof in Rooftop Shooters. Time your jumps and shots so you can stay on the building while pushing the other player over the edge. Try online multiplayer, share a keyboard in local two-player mode, or practice on your own. Win matches to unlock new skins.

pages.title: Square Clicker
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Click the white square to earn money in Square Clicker. Use what you earn to buy upgrades that improve the square and raise your income. Decide when to spend on something you can afford and when to keep saving for another upgrade. Keep clicking to see how far you can build up your earnings.

pages.title: Ferrari F8 Spider Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together pictures of the Ferrari F8 Spider in Ferrari F8 Spider Puzzle. Choose one of six scenes and a puzzle size from 16 up to 100 pieces. Look for sections of the bodywork or background that line up across the edges. Return to a familiar picture with more pieces for a harder version.

pages.title: Baby Hazel African Safari
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Visit South Africa with Hazel, her parents, and Bruno in Baby Hazel African Safari. After seeing Cape Town, the family spends a night in a safari tent. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and help her through the activities as the visit moves from the city into the wilderness.

pages.title: Maze Rotator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Rotate a maze instead of steering through it directly in Maze Rotator. Use A and D or the left and right arrows to turn the layout, and press Space to start. Think about where the maze will lead after each turn. Work through the levels by choosing when to rotate and when to hold the current angle.

pages.title: Beat Dropper
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Change shapes and move to the rhythm in Beat Dropper. Tap to move, or tap your shape to switch it before you run into another one. Take out the shapes that match yours and avoid the others. Play through different music tracks and choose a difficulty that suits the speed you can handle.

pages.title: Boat Rescue
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pilot a rescue boat and bring survivors back to the ship in Boat Rescue. Use WASD to steer and approach each person closely enough to pick them up. Once everyone is aboard, head back and line up the boat for the return. Work through the rescue missions one level at a time.

pages.title: Wild Animals Puzzle
pages.creator: Aurora Games
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of wild animals in Wild Animals Puzzle. Study the shapes and markings on the loose pieces to see how they fit together. Connect the pieces you recognize first, then look for the details that link the remaining sections. Finish the jigsaw to reveal the whole animal scene.

pages.title: Good Luck Racer 2
pages.creator: VE-GAME
pages.description: Try stunt driving or a city police pursuit in Good Luck Racer 2. Combine flips with other tricks, pick up money, and save it for a different car. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive and C to switch camera views. The city mode gives you a different kind of challenge from the stunt runs.

pages.title: Mahjong
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Remove pairs from a pyramid of tiles in Mahjong. Look for two identical tiles that are available to play and clear them together. Taking tiles off the top opens others underneath, so decide which match will give you more choices. Keep pairing tiles until the board is empty.

pages.title: Thief vs Cops
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Escape police cars in Thief vs Cops. Use the mouse to steer, pick up fuel, and use turbo when you need to get away quickly. The pursuing cars leave acid trails, so watch the route they've taken as well as where they are now. See how long you can keep clear of both.

pages.title: Car vs Cops
pages.creator: F2K2.com
pages.description: Let police cars get close, then dodge them in Car vs Cops. Watch the direction a pursuer is taking and move away before it touches your car. Each successful dodge adds to your points, so make room for the next close call as you try to build a higher score.

pages.title: Hangman
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Guess the name of a fruit or vegetable in Hangman. Pick letters and use the ones you uncover to recognize the word. Each wrong letter brings the drawing closer to completion. Take your time and use the produce theme to narrow down which letters are worth trying next.

pages.title: Café Paris
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Run a Paris coffee shop in Café Paris. Watch what customers need and react quickly enough to keep service moving. Decide which request to handle when several people need attention. The challenge is staying organized as the café gets busy and completing the orders your customers came in for.

pages.title: Bouncy Golf
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Send a golf ball toward the goal in Bouncy Golf. Touch and drag to aim, then release and watch how the ball bounces through the course. Judge the angle before the shot so the ball can get around the terrain. Look for a line that takes it past stars along the way.

pages.title: Color Twins
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Rotate the shape to line up its colors in Color Twins. Look at the color the next match requires before you turn it. The level is finished when every required color has been matched, while incorrect matches hurt your performance. Work through 25 stages and check the alignment as the patterns change.

pages.title: Ice Queen Romantic Date
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Set up a date for the Ice Queen and her boyfriend in Ice Queen Romantic Date. Search the scene for hidden red hearts first. Once they're found, try different outfits for the couple and arrange decorations around them. Put the setting and the clothes together to create the date you want them to have.

pages.title: Wheely 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help a little car catch up with his love in Wheely 2. Look at each scene and work out what needs to happen before Wheely can drive onward. Use the puzzle elements in the right order so the way forward opens. Then help him continue his search in the next scene.

pages.title: Viking Pub
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Serve hungry Vikings in Viking Pub. The crew has just returned from a voyage and wants beef and mead. Watch what they need and send out the right food or drink before falling behind. Keep serving as the Vikings come in and see how many you can feed.

pages.title: Samantha Plum: The Globetrotting Chef 3
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Search for hidden objects in Samantha Plum: The Globetrotting Chef 3. Samantha and her father Dominique are working to put their restaurant, The Loving Table, on the map with a special stew. Check each scene for the objects they need and help the pair pursue a Golden Fork award.

pages.title: Snow White Patchwork
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Design a patchwork dress for Snow White in Snow White Patchwork. Her old blue-and-yellow dress was damaged while she picked apples, and she wants to try something new. Choose the top and combine fabrics and patterns for the replacement. See how the different patches work together before settling on the design.

pages.title: Food Grinder
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Keep a piece of food away from saws in Food Grinder. Move it up or down when a blade is coming and pick up diamonds to improve your score. Collect coins as you go and spend them on other characters to play. Watch both directions before moving to reach the next pickup.

pages.title: Princesses Beach Day
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style two princesses for a day by the sea in Princesses Beach Day. Choose swimsuits and hairstyles for both, then bring them cocktails on the beach. Put together a different look for each princess if you like. Once they're ready, the pair takes selfies to share their day out.
